title: Rank deficiency of Bernoulli random matrices for growing corank
summary: Let A be an n x n Bernoulli random matrix whose entries are i.i.d. Bernoulli(p) random variables. In this paper, we determine the probability that the corank of A is at least k when k is of order o(sqrt(log n)): P(corank A >= k) = (1-p+o_n(1))^(kn).
